dedupe_keys.name: surewave d6 1 ultimate strength capacity of critical connections

description: Virgile, Delhaye and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The experimental study evaluates connections between photovoltaic modules, floating breakwater elements and their interfaces. Polyurethane hinges, steel ropes and connection mechanisms undergo tensile, compressive, shear and torsional loading. The source describes load-displacement behaviour, stiffness, deformation and failure modes. These laboratory results support structural validation of offshore renewable-energy connections. The deposited report does not establish a separate public machine-readable acquisition dataset or full-scale offshore durability across all marine environments. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. This record represents the documented application and its stated scope. Publication access does not imply that its underlying measurements or implementation are public. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. Connection measurements provide inputs for related offshore-PV structural validation.
